title: Messaging and illustration quartet
slide_intent: Compare several ways of expressing one promise because a brand needs variation without losing its recognizable voice.
strategic_value: Repeated green, rounded type and character imagery can hold Duolingo’s encouraging messages together.
demonstration: Four rounded tiles pair brief language-learning phrases with green fields, Duo poses and gray supporting text.
practical_value: Compare the balance of headline, mascot and supporting copy across a small message family.

content_islands.name: Upper tiles
content_islands.spec: Pair the text-only “go further” sequence with the “Language never stands still” tile and cropped Duo.

content_islands.name: Lower tiles
content_islands.spec: Pair the waving Duo and “Goodbye language barriers” with the green “as easy as uno dos tres” tile.

reference_purposes.Expression: Four tiles vary language and character placement while repeating green and rounded typography.
reference_purposes.Application: The artwork demonstrates several composed message tiles using the identity.
